steps.what: Walk the facilities and see which supplies are short.
Decide which supplies to order for the facilities.
Draft facility order v1 for the supplies she just saw.
Send facility order v1 after checking item and quantity.

tasks.design: She walks the facilities, decides which supplies to order, drafts facility order v1 in {PROCUREMENT}, and sends that version to the supplier. No model drafts the order or sends it. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The shortage is something she has to see in the facilities before an order can name an item and a quantity.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new walks the facilities or decides the supplies for her.
tasks.still_hard: A shortage she did not see stays unordered.
tasks.human_edge: She can refuse to order an item she did not see.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still sees the shortage and places the order.

reach.learn: A supply order goes out only as the version she checked.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she orders facility supplies herself after she has seen what is short, and this residence does not use a room draw or a lesson tool for that order.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
She is the producer of the shortage she saw. The fields on facility order v1 are the item and the quantity she just saw. If she did not see an item she does not order it.

No model drafts the order. The draft step is her own writing and is not gated. She checks the item and the quantity on the send step, which is the gate. No model sends it. No alert is raised. No listing is produced in place of the walk.
unknowns: Whether a second person must countersign a supply order.
research_questions: Who else may change facility order v1 after she has sent it?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one supply round she walks the facilities, decides which supplies to order, drafts facility order v1, and sends that version, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the departmental budget figures in the finance record.
Oversee whether spending still fits the departmental budget.

tasks.design: She opens the departmental budget in {ERP} and reads the figures herself, then oversees whether spending still fits. No listing replaces that reading. She files no new version and sends nothing. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether spending still fits is a judgement she makes after she has read the figures.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new reads the departmental budget or judges the fit for her.
tasks.still_hard: A missing figure stays unread, and she does not invent it.
tasks.human_edge: She can refuse to treat a figure she did not open as known.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still opens the departmental budget and oversees the spending.

reach.learn: The departmental budget is read by the person who oversees it.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she opens and reads the departmental budget herself before she oversees spending, and a room-assignment tool does not do that reading.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The finance colleague keeps the departmental budget. The fields are the department, the amount planned, and the amount spent. If a figure is missing she does not invent it.

She still opens and reads the record. That reading is the first step. It is not free and it is not saved. No listing replaces the reading. No model judges the budget. She files no new version and sends nothing. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether a finance officer must confirm the figures before she oversees them.
research_questions: Who else may change a planned amount after she has overseen it?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one month she reads the departmental budget and oversees that department's spending, and neither step is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Watch students do the housekeeping in the residence.
Judge whether that housekeeping was done properly.
Supervise students and ensure the housekeeping is done properly.

tasks.design: She watches the students do the housekeeping, judges whether it was done properly, and tells them. No checklist is filed and nothing is sent. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether the housekeeping was done properly is something she has to see.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new watches the students or judges the housekeeping for her.
tasks.still_hard: A room she did not watch stays unchecked.
tasks.human_edge: She can correct only the housekeeping she watched.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still watches the housekeeping and supervises the students.

reach.learn: Housekeeping is judged from what she watched, not from a generated checklist.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she watches the students' housekeeping and corrects them in person, and a lesson or room tool does not supervise that work.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Students are residents, not colleagues. She watches them, then tells them in person.
No written warning is filed and nothing is sent, so there is no version to gate. No checklist is generated. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether the residence later requires a written warning for poor housekeeping.
research_questions: Whether any later task, not this one, files a written housekeeping warning.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one round she watches the students' housekeeping, judges whether it was done properly, and supervises them, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Hear why students are unable to follow residence policies.
Decide the contract cancellations for students unable to follow procedures.
Process contract cancellations and file cancellation v1.
Tell the student that cancellation v1 now stands.

tasks.design: She hears why the student cannot follow the residence policies, decides the cancellation, files cancellation v1 in {CLM}, and tells the student in person. No model decides the cancellation. No written notice is sent. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: A residence cancellation has to rest on the policy and on what the student told her.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new hears the student or decides the cancellation for her.
tasks.still_hard: A fact she did not hear stays off the cancellation.
tasks.human_edge: She can leave blank a policy or a date she does not have.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still decides the cancellation and tells the student.

reach.learn: A residence cancellation is her decision, not an automatic room draw.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she decides a residence contract cancellation from the policy and from what the student told her, and a room draw does not make that decision.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

She heard the student in the first step. The fields she files are the student, the policy or procedure she cannot follow, and the date. If a fact is missing she leaves it blank and does not invent it.

No model decides the cancellation and no room draw decides it. Cancellation v1 is the only standing version. She approves it on the filing step. She then tells the student in person. No written notice is sent, so the telling is not a second gated send. No alert is raised. The residence contract record is the {CLM} category.
unknowns: Whether a written cancellation notice must be sent.
research_questions: Who else may reopen cancellation v1 after she has filed it?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one cancellation she hears why the student cannot follow residence policies, decides, files cancellation v1, and tells the student, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

role.altitude: She still sees shortages and orders supplies, reads and oversees the budget, supervises housekeeping, and processes cancellations. Nothing is handed off.
reach: A childcare worker learns a supply order is sent only as the version she checked.
A concierge learns a residence cancellation is her decision, not an automatic room draw.
skills_to_grow: Watch the housekeeping before she corrects it.
Cancel from the policy and the student, not from a room draw.
role.ambitious_version: The same advisor still orders, oversees, supervises, and cancels. No order, budget verdict, housekeeping correction, or cancellation is sent in her place.
